description: This file defines an abstract class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform' that provides a framework for attribute transformations in the HTMLPurifier library. It includes methods for transforming attribute arrays, prepending CSS styles, and confiscating attributes, which are used to process and sanitize HTML attributes according to certain rules.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform
classes.description: An abstract base class for attribute transformations that modify HTML element attributes before or after validation within the HTMLPurifier library.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Abstract method to make changes to the attribute array based on multiple values. Must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: prependCSS
methods.description: Prepends CSS property declarations to the style attribute within the attribute array.

methods.name: confiscateAttr
methods.description: Retrieves and removes a specific attribute from the attribute array.
